tasks.title: Project cache plan into openai-responses payloads

tasks.title: Project cache plan into anthropic payloads with additive cache_control optimization
tasks.notes: `packages/ai/src/providers/anthropic.ts` now projects shared cache-plan `system` and `context` layers into separate `system` blocks, each with additive `cache_control`, while preserving sorted tools and history behavior. Verified with `npm test -w @kennyfrc/mu-ai -- anthropic-prompt-cache-policy.red.test.ts prompt-cache-policy.test.ts openai-completions-prompt-cache-policy.test.ts openai-responses-prompt-cache-policy.test.ts`.
